# Quarterly Security Review

## Summary

In today's fast-paced digital landscape, it is important to note that vulnerability management plays a crucial role in protecting our systems. This quarter, we delved into 42 new CVEs, highlighting the need for robust processes. Furthermore, our team leveraged automation to streamline triage, ensuring faster response times.

Ultimately, the results are a testament to our commitment to security, collaboration, and excellence — and they pave the way for continued success.

## Findings

- We patched **CVE-2026-109619** in 3 days, down from 9 days last quarter.
- Dependency scanning now covers npm, PyPI, and Composer — a significant step forward.
- See the [full report](https://example.com/report.pdf) for details [1].

| Area | Status | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Scanning | Fully operational and seamlessly integrated | Platform team |
| Patching | Meticulously tracked across all services | SRE |

```bash
python3 scan.py --days 90
```

## Next steps

1. Moreover, we will expand coverage to Go modules by 2027-01-15.
2. Additionally, we will reduce mean time to patch to under 48 hours.

In conclusion, by fostering a culture of security, we can unlock the full potential of our platform. Run `status.py` weekly.
